Start and stop say what went wrong instead of appearing to do nothing.

## 🐞 Fixed

- **The play/stop controls swallowed every failure.** `.catch(() => {})` around the group toggle and a bare `null` from the stats fetch meant that an instance refusing a call, a token that had expired and a relay that never answered all rendered as the same silent nothing — so a button that was failing every single time looked exactly like a button that did nothing. Failures are collected and shown now: one line under the summary for a start/stop that did not take, and the reason in place of the figures on a card that could not read them. One unreachable instance also no longer cancels the others.
- **The figures come from the server's own counters** (`/api/queue/counters`) rather than being derived a second time from the task list. That endpoint existed the whole time and is what the browser extension reads; deriving them here meant two calls per instance and a second, quietly different definition of "how many files" — the server counts files *owed*, excluding what is finished, failed or collected.

## ⚡ Improved

- **The summary card is the same box as the cards it summarises** — same margin, same padding, same gap. It had its own numbers and stood visibly out of line.
- **The mark in the overview is the mark, not the launcher tile.** `icon.png` is the finished tile with the ground baked in, so on a card it read as a little app icon pasted onto the page.
- **The bin is filled**, like the gear before it. It was three uprights and a base, which is what a *stroked* bin draws — and a line-drawn glyph among filled badges is the one thing the icon rule rules out.
- **"Follow the instance" is "Follow the default instance"**, and the line under it now says plainly what it does. In all 42 languages.
- **The accent label is ordinary row text.** Once it sits beside its control rather than above a group, it is a row label like every other one on the page.
- **The "connected" line only appears when it is not.** It was true almost always, so it said nothing on the space it occupied; still connecting, or dropped, is worth saying.
- **"Übersicht" is a button**, not a bare word among square badges.
